name: CrediBadge
author: erdincbulat

sections.description:
CrediBadge is a high-performance plugin designed to strengthen your site’s authority in the eyes of Google. By implementing core E-E-A-T (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, and Trustworthiness) signals, it bridges the gap between expert content and search engine recognition.

Unlike simple badge plugins, this tool generates deep JSON-LD Schema data. It dynamically switches between ‘Article’ (for posts) and ‘WebPage’ (for pages) types while injecting ‘reviewedBy’ and ‘sameAs’ social authority links.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the credibadge folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Access ‘Settings > CrediBadge’ to configure your global styles and icons.
sections.changelog:
1.4.7

  • Plugin renamed to CrediBadge for better brand identity.
  • Complete code audit for WordPress security standards.
  • Enhanced JSON-LD Article Schema logic.

short_description: Professional content verification tool for E-E-A-T SEO. Features expert trust badges, automated Article/WebPage JSON-LD schema, and Elementor support.
